widgets.text: Customize your B-Daman's parts for power, speed or control. Each character's B-Daman has a special shot.
Hit targets or the rival's B-Daman before time runs out; power shots break through blocking marbles.
Follow Yamato and friends through tournaments in the B-Da world, with free roaming between matches.
Win matches to earn parts; equip them in the custom menu.
Collect every part to build the strongest B-Daman.
Win each tournament to advance the story.
